name: @omadia/spike-meeting-audio-sidecar
description: Spike S1' (byte5ai/omadia#584, ADR-0287): headless Chromium + ACS Calling SDK joins a Teams meeting as the agent's tenant user and streams mixed remote audio as PCM frames. Not part of the plugin build or package.

scripts.build: esbuild page.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=out/page.js --log-level=warning && esbuild run.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=out/run.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild sink.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=out/sink.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.self-test: npm run build && TEAMS_MEETING_AUDIO_SPIKE=1 node out/run.mjs --self-test --seconds 3
